title: brindled baud-rate
style: English, intimate lofi trap merger, syncopated 808 sub-bass ricochets, tape flutter, imperfect choral and duet whispers, cybernetic sprung-rhythm cadence, 128 BPM
lyrics:
[Intro - Intimate Whispered Choral, Tape Flutter, Sub-Bass Hum]
(Voice 1) Dappled pings in deep fiber-folds...
(Voice 2) Cold-kernel cached, unmapped range.

[Verse 1 - Sprung Cadence, Syncopated Close-Mic Whispers, Angular Guitars]
Morning’s admin, flash-cache wing,
Brindled baud-rate, binary-bright,
Bus-line tangled in dead-link night,
Instress, bit-sire, spit-myre,
Brimming over, slow collapse...

[Chorus - Heavy Lofi 808 Drop, Rolling Ricochet Hats, Duet Vocals]
Inscape lattice, velvet numb!
Rolling touch as the traces come!
Sub-bass plunges raw-wound wire,
Parity permeable, phosphor glow,
Fold the current down below!

[Bridge - Sudden Tape-Decay Breakdown, Fragile Drone]
Bleed out the beat.
Breathe in the bus.
Rock-racked router, sprung and slight,
Glitch-cluster clicking in soft backlight.

[Outro - Syncopated Ricochet Fade]
Not a frame dropped...
Caught in the crawl.
